Hi! I am a Research Assistant at the Biomedical Imaging Center (CIB) UC. I am a Mathematical and Computational Engineer and I earned my M.Sc. at the Institute for Mathematical and Computational Engineering UC (IMC). My M.Sc. thesis is available here.

I hold a B.Sc. in Engineering Physics (1st gen!), with a minor in Applied Mathematics.

You can find my CV here!

The News 😎

  • (May 2026) Thrilled to have presented two works, in both an oral session and a poster presentation, at the 2026 ISMRM & ISMRT Annual Meeting & Exhibition, in Cape Town!
  • (April 2026) I presented my work "Demixing Streaking for Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping" done at CIB UC at the IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2026, in London!
  • (January 2026) I presented a poster at Inverse Problems in the Physical Sciences IPPhys2026 Summer School, Puerto Varas.
  • (November 2024) A poster resulting from my MSc Thesis was accepted at ENIM 2024 :).
  • (November 2023) I participated in "MRI:Processing your Data (in Julia)" Here is a certificate and pictures. Very fun tutorials on advance topics in MRI!
  • (October 2023) Our Team won the first place at HackSciML! (Hackathon on Scientific Machine Learning). A cute picture here (Instagram).
  • (April 2023) I was awarded the SIAM Student Chapter Certificate of Recognition 2023! An interview about the prize and the SIAM-PUC Student Chapter can be found here! (in spanish).
